instruction: Use the Autodesk Fusion 360 GUI in the Manufacture workspace. Open the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\simple_cam_job.step. Create a complete basic manufacturing program containing Face, Drill, and 2D Contour operations for the provided part. Configure the setup WCS, stock, operations, tool numbers, spindle speeds, and feed rates inside Fusion 360. Tool definitions: T1 is a 10 mm end mill for facing and contouring; T2 is a 5 mm drill for the holes. In the NC Program or post-process dialog, use metric units and the selected post processor for this setup, then export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-6.nc to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths.
